_comment: Served at https://bookos.es/api/releases.json. Client appends ?channel=<stable|beta|dev>. It reads by_channel[<channel>] (canonical object form), falling back to releases[] or latest. Each release MUST have `version` (drives the update check vs INSTALLED= in /etc/bookos-release) and size_human|size, changelog_url, notes, notes_en. `version` must match the bookos-meta RPM published in that channel repo. STATE: dev = 0.6.1 (the channel being published). stable/beta stay at 0.6 until their 0.6.1 RPMs are signed+published — bumping a channel here before its repo has the matching version makes devices see an update that fails to install. `size`/`size_human` is the download shown in Settings; set it to the real delta of the bookos-* packages the dnf upgrade pulls.

stable.notes:
BookOS 0.6.
• Rediseño cohesivo del escritorio (estilo macOS)
• Nuevo centro de control y Ajustes
• Widgets integrados en el set de release
• Mejoras de batería y rendimiento
stable.notes_en:
BookOS 0.6.
• Cohesive desktop redesign (macOS-style)
• New control center and Settings
• Widgets pinned into the release set
• Battery and performance improvements

beta.notes: BookOS 0.6 beta.\n• Mismas novedades que stable, antes de tiempo\n• Posibles inestabilidades
beta.notes_en: BookOS 0.6 beta.\n• Same features as stable, ahead of time\n• Possible instabilities

dev.notes:
BookOS 0.6.1 (dev).
• Panel y dock corregidos (alturas, ajuste/relleno, flotante)
• Widgets se instalan de forma fiable
• Repositorios firmados (actualizaciones verificadas)

dev.notes_en:
BookOS 0.6.1 (dev).
• Panel and dock fixed (heights, fit/fill, floating)
• Widgets install reliably
